counterexamples.finding: CRCDcellDICE96.11−79.02=17.09points, not printed20.09; abstract repeats20.09. PUMAtissue30%annotation83.51vs100%92.11DICE is8.60point gap, not equivalentwithoutcriterion. Four pathology datasets yield six tissue/cell evaluation tasks, not six independent datasets. Foreground-onlycell metric and uncertain aggregate definitions should remain explicit. No seed variance/split/patient-level protocol or full baseline training budgets verified.

Laplace density normalizer printed1/(sqrt2 b) vs standard1/(2b) inFig6; tails described faster than Gaussian despite heavier Laplace tail. A assumes Gaussian-style closure of independent Laplace sums, unweighted mixture densitysum, and signed Laplace noise alwaysnonnegative to remove absolute values; these require correction/justification. Fig6scales not variance-matched, cannot establish universal separation or segmentation superiority. Keep unresolved derivation issues separate from empirical scores; no theorem certification.

Student-tvsLaplace runtime comparison lacks a stated equal hardware/training/inference scope and no general Gaussianbaseline wallclock. Noise steps5–15 andtemperature0.05–0.1dependonhardware. Biomedical segmentation scores/WSIexamples do not prove diagnosis benefit or deployment readiness;clinicalstatementexplicitlyresearchonly. PanNukeTable7cell19categories/radarorganlabels andmetricDicevsIoUaveraging need dataset-specific reconciliation. Do not propagate every issue into manuscript prose or blanket invalidity.
